concerns.text: T019_pilot [US0] consumes the metric‑extraction script implemented in T019 [US1], but T019 is listed later (Phase 4). This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule and FR‑010 (foundational tasks must precede any consumer).
T032d is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) yet explicitly depends on T014a (fetch and archive real stimuli). Because it must wait for T014a to finish, it is not parallel‑safe; the `[P]` tag is incorrect.

Unit‑test tasks T015, T016, T017, and T018 are scheduled before the directory‑setup task T018a (Create isolated test‑data directories). The tests will fail if the directories do not exist, so the ordering is invalid.

T032a (Dataset Version & Source Recording) is placed before T032 (Fetch Real Meeting Clips) even though its description says it records information *when* fetching occurs. The dependency is inverted, causing a producer‑before‑consumer violation.
